title: Transport of the counit stalk condition from localized cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, and $g':X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] forming a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change]. Let $G$ be any cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and write $\epsilon_{g'}(G):L(g')^*Q(G)\to Q((g')^*G)$ for the universal derived-to-ordinary pullback counit [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. At $z\in X'$ set $R=\mathcal O_{S,f(g'z)}$, $A=\mathcal O_{X,g'z}$, $B=\mathcal O_{S',f'z}$, and $C=\mathcal O_{X',z}$ with the actual stalk-map algebra structures [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Suppose for every $z$ and $i\in\mathbb Z$ the localized comparison of the canonical model [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for $G_{g'z}$, from $H^i(G_{g'z}\otimes_R^L B)\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}C$ to $H^i(G_{g'z}\otimes_A C)$, is an isomorphism. Then $\epsilon_{g'}(G)$ satisfies the coordinate-independent stalk condition [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]: the displayed stalkComparison is invertible in every degree and at every point for every K-flat coordinate system of this counit.

proof.text: Fix coordinates c and a point z. Exactness of module stalks transports c.e and c.e' to isomorphisms on derived stalk cohomology. Restriction of scalars is exact. The universal derived scalar-extension property therefore gives an isomorphism from the source computed on c.P to the source computed on G, respecting the A-tensor-B action and its final extension to C.

The coordinate represents identity fixes c.t after localization to be the universal counit on G. The comparison_eq and localized_eq equations of the model, naturality of the universal counit, and the degreewise tensorStalkIso identify stalkComparison c with localizedComparison for G, conjugated by the source and target cohomology isomorphisms of step 1.
Composition with isomorphisms preserves invertibility; apply the hypothesis at z and i and quantify over all c,z,i.
